criteria.criterion: A unit test in crates/athena-core/src/run.rs shows unmet_criteria returns nothing for a report that marks a full-suite criterion (clippy, fmt --check and workspace cargo test) as left to Athena's checks, and still returns a targeted-test criterion that the report omits. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria.evidence: Test a_full_suite_criterion_left_to_athenas_checks_is_not_sent_back_but_an_omitted_targeted_one_is passed when I ran it. It asserts unmet_criteria returns only the targeted criterion ('cargo test -p athena-core passes the new test'), and left_to_athena lists the full-suite one. Without the new `left && marked_left(c)` branch, the full-suite entry (status unmet) would also be returned, so the test would fail.

criteria.criterion: A test shows a criterion marked 'left to Athena's checks' that is not an Athena-check criterion (for example a targeted-test or content criterion) is still returned as unmet and sent back. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria.evidence: Test the_marker_does_not_excuse_other_criteria_or_an_unmarked_unmet_one passed. A content criterion and a targeted criterion, both marked with the prefix, plus an unmarked unmet full-suite criterion are all returned by unmet_criteria, and left_to_athena is empty. only_unscoped_cargo_checks_count_as_athena_check_criteria also passed.

criteria.criterion: A test shows the verifier still fails the job when the recorded full-suite check fails, even though the producer left that criterion to Athena's checks. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria.evidence: Test a_failed_recorded_check_still_fails_a_criterion_the_producer_left_to_athena passed. It confirms the report is not sent back (unmet empty). It then runs verify::judge with a failed CheckRun (exit 101) and a verifier output saying Pass with the criterion met. The test asserts final_verdict == Fail and that reasons contains 'check test failed'. In run.rs (around line 2029), the left-over criteria are only added as an informational CheckResultView in the verifier brief (passed: true, 'not a check'), the same way the existing producer-report-gaps entry works, so they cannot override the recorded checks.

criteria.criterion: The producer brief's criteria_check section in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs tells the producer to mark a criterion that only Athena's recorded checks (fmt, clippy, the full test suite) can show as left to Athena's checks, with the exact marker text, and says targeted-test criteria must still be reported met with evidence. A briefs.rs test asserts that wording.
criteria.evidence: In the diff, criteria_check_section adds a paragraph naming cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy and the full or workspace cargo test. It tells the producer to start the evidence with the LEFT_TO_ATHENA marker ("left to Athena's checks"), and says 'Targeted-test criteria and every other criterion must still be reported met with evidence'. Test producer_brief_tells_how_to_leave_a_criterion_to_athenas_checks asserts this wording and passed.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the change: self-check no longer sends back criteria left to Athena's checks.
criteria.evidence: There is a new entry under Unreleased > Changed. It says the self-check no longer sends back criteria left to Athena's checks, explains the marker and the unscoped-cargo rule, says a failed recorded check still fails the job and that targeted-test and content criteria still go back, and gives the root cause.

criteria.criterion: cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --all-targets are clean, and cargo test passes for the workspace (Athena's recorded checks).
criteria.evidence: Athena's records for this tree show fmt, clippy and test all passed, with 1279 tests run.

findings.summary: The Athena-check classifier only looks for the words: any criterion that mentions 'cargo test' without a scope flag can be left to Athena's checks, even when it is really a targeted behavior check.
findings.evidence: is_athena_check_criterion returns true when the text contains 'cargo test' and none of -p/--package/--test/--lib/--bin/--doc/--bench/--example appear. A criterion such as 'cargo test shows the new parser rejects empty input' would count as an Athena-check criterion, so a producer could leave it with the marker and skip the send-back. The verifier still judges it, so this is not harmful, but the self-check gets weaker there.

summary: The change does what was asked. The producer self-check now skips a criterion when the producer marks its evidence with "left to Athena's checks" and the criterion text names fmt, clippy or an unscoped cargo test. Content and targeted-test criteria still go back to the producer even if marked. The left-over criteria are passed to the verifier as an informational note only, and a test confirms that verify::judge still fails the job when the recorded test check fails. The producer brief and the outputs.rs doc comment explain the marker, and a briefs.rs test checks that wording. The CHANGELOG entry is clear. I ran the new targeted tests and they pass. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test checks also passed. All four changed files are on the expected deliverables list. One minor issue: the classifier only matches words in the criterion text, so a criterion that mentions an unscoped "cargo test" but describes specific behavior could be left without a send-back. The verifier still judges such a criterion.
